  "memo":"Only R03 holds: the card issuing and IP countries differ, and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The applicable table row is §6.6(b), but the failed required id_check now decides under §5.3(b): decline and block the account, without escalating to linked accounts. A legitimate foreign-card purchase remains conceivable, and repayment history is favorable, but neither overrides the failed check. The order has already shipped, so the loss stands. No further check would change the prescribed disposition."
